description: Source code for a handler class that manages cost tracking and logging for Vertex AI Live API WebSocket passthrough endpoints, supporting multiple modalities such as text, audio, video, and web search.

classes.name: VertexAILivePassthroughLoggingHandler

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _extract_usage_metadata_from_websocket_messages( websocket_messages: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Extracts and aggregates usage metadata from a list of WebSocket messages, combining counts and token details across multiple messages.

methods.name: float _calculate_live_api_cost( model: str, usage_metadata: Dict, custom_llm_provider: str = "vertex_ai", )
methods.description: Calculates total cost based on usage metadata and model-specific pricing, including support for modalities such as audio and video.

methods.name: Usage _create_usage_object_from_metadata( usage_metadata: Dict, model: str, )
methods.description: Creates a Usage object from usage metadata, prioritizing text token counts but falling back on total counts if necessary.
